Chat request with reasoning_effort none, which turns reasoning off instead of being rejected

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ReasoningEffort, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ content: "What is 2+2? One word.", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-5.1", reasoningEffort: ReasoningEffort.None });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
}

void main();
```
